sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release tracklist: the archive's Medium images (disc and record labels) appear as small thumbnails in the heading of the medium they show; a click opens the viewer on that medium's images. The archive does not say which medium an image shows, so one is placed only when that is certain — the release has one medium; its comment names exactly one existing medium ("disc 2", "CD 2", "LP 2", or "side C" on vinyl and cassettes, two sides per medium); or no Medium image has a comment and there are exactly as many as media (archive order). Everything else is listed in one note on the first medium ("4 Medium images, 3 media, no comments: not assigned") that opens them in the viewer. At most four thumbnails per medium, then "+N". No request of its own. New setting "Show Medium images in each medium heading" (on by default; needs the Cover art section).

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New spec release-tracks-medium-art.spec.js (10 tests); the mobile spec adds a tap on a medium thumb. release-tracks-cover-art-p4.json gains 13 defects for this, all caught. docs/claude/artwork-caa-eaa.md records the assignment order and the h3 click trap (a bare target collapses the medium); docs/claude/testing-playwright.md records why locator.tap() can report a false "intercepts pointer events" once the visual viewport has scrolled.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release page Cover art section: a third layout, Spreads, next to Grid and By type. Two images of the same type whose comments differ only in a final "left"/"right" ("opened gatefold cover, inside left" + "… inside right") are shown side by side as one opened spread; the Liner and Booklet pages are turned two at a time with ◀ ▶; everything else follows as single pages. Pairing only happens when it is unambiguous (two lefts for one comment, or a left and right of different types, stay single), and no image is ever hidden. The chips apply, the choice is remembered, and the viewer opened from a tile steps through the spreads order including the liner pages the pager hides. No request of its own.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New spec release-tracks-cover-art-spreads.spec.js (7 tests); the mobile spec checks that a spread fits a phone window. Mutation list scripts/mutations/release-tracks-cover-art-p4.json: 8 planted defects caught, plus one recorded overlap (the spread's own width cap is covered by the section's). docs/claude/artwork-caa-eaa.md gains the pairing and viewer-order rules.
